messages:
sam: Looping everyone on a new pricing construct the OEM asked for: co-billing option, reseller margin waterfall, trial credits for first 30 days, and a renewal auto-adjust clause. Need quick alignment.

lia: Co-billing is doable but ops will need clear invoice flow. Are we doing a single invoice with line item split, or separate invoices per party?

omar: Recommend single invoice to buyer, with partner revenue share done off-platform (reconciliation). Simpler for buyer UX. Finance: objections?

finance-bot: note: single invoice ok if partner revenue share is handled via vendor payouts. Need partner bank details and a quarterly reconciliation schedule. Also require liability cap and max credit exposure per deal.

nina: For trial credits, customer wants 30-day free trial that counts toward committed volume if they convert. Proposal: trial up to $20k counts as pre-paid usage if customer signs PO within 45 days. Otherwise expires. Legal to weigh in.

lia: Marketplace listing constraints: cannot show conditional trial text. We'll put trial mechanics in the PO PDF and ensure SKU is static. Ops: we should add a distinct 'TRIAL-APPL' SKU to map credits internally.

sam: Good call. Draft SKU matrix idea below for ops review:
```
SKU: RWD-HW-SW-PAIR-TRIAL
Commit tiers (annualized): 100k, 300k, 600k
Reseller waterfall: base price -> reseller allowance 10% -> OEM margin 6% -> partner rebate pool 4%
Trial credit: up to 20k (applies if PO signed within 45 days)
Co-billing: single invoice to buyer; partner payouts post-quarterly reconciliation
Grace: 60-day cure window before post-commit adjustment
```
Can marketplace-admin confirm SKU naming rules?

marketplace-admin: reply: SKU names ok. Private-offer docs can include trial mechanics & co-billing notes. Marketplace UI won't display waterfall math; include a one-pager PDF attachment with the private offer. Also confirm we can attach a separate TRIAL SKU line to every private offer.

omar: For reseller margin waterfall, we need an internal split table per deal. Partner-success, can you own partner payout ops and signoff?

partner-success: Yes. We'll require partner W9/ACH details and an onboarding packet. Also propose a partner performance holdback: 10% of rebate pool held until 90 days post-go-live to reduce churn exposure.

finance-bot: addition: cap trial-credit exposure to $50k per partner per quarter across all deals to limit liability. Also require a monthly aging report for credits applied.

nina: Renewal auto-adjust clause idea: if actual annualized usage > 110% of committed tier for 2 consecutive months during month 9-11, system auto-offers an upgrade with retro credit for past 3 months. Customer can opt out within 15 days. Legal wants soft language.

sam: Marketing asks: co-announce copy freeze 8 business days before listing and 3 localized decks for field. Also need a buyer-facing worked example of trial -> commit conversion.

om ar: (typo) ignore

lia: Ops ticket created: "Private Offer - TRIAL SKU + Co-billing mapping" Ticket #88420. Assignees: marketplace-admin, lia. Due: 2024-11-10.

partner-success: Action items:
- partner-success: collect partner payout details & onboarding packet by 2024-10-25
- lia: submit SKU matrix + TRIAL SKU request to ticket #88420 by 2024-10-20
- nina: draft trial-credit T&Cs and renewal auto-adjust language for legal by 2024-10-18
- sam: prepare buyer worked example + co-announce asset request to marketing by 2024-10-22
- finance-bot: provide credit exposure cap and reporting template by 2024-10-19

sam: One last point: fallback for under-delivery after 60-day grace should present two clear options: (A) post-commit consumption adjustment at agreed tier rate (presented as adjustment, not "fee"); or (B) downgrade to nearest lower tier pro-rated. Keep customer choice.

partner-success: We'll add an AE+CS review for shortfalls >20% before auto-adjustment. Helps avoid churn surprises.

marketplace-admin: Confirmed: we can attach one PDF to the private offer with full waterfall + trial mechanics and a separate TRIAL SKU line. Proceeding to validate listing fields in ticket.

sam: Great. I'll assemble the pilot brief and ping legal for quick review. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
